labels.moduleOff: This module is switched off in Settings → Enabled modules.
labels.resetRate: Reset the public form's rate limits
labels.calcIntro: What the wash can take with the numbers above (before saving). Cars per hour and per day are computed by the same planner that offers times to customers.
labels.calcError: The calculation failed. Check the numbers.
labels.warn_washers_lt_posts: Fewer washers than bays: some bays can never be used at the same time.
labels.warn_online_share_zero: Online share is 0 %: the form and the chat will offer no times.
labels.warn_no_duration: No duration set: 30 minutes are assumed.
labels.warn_buffer_gt_duration: The buffer between cars is longer than the wash itself.
labels.warn_hour_cap_binds: The cars-per-hour limit is lower than the lines could do.
labels.warn_day_cap_binds: The cars-per-day limit is lower than the day could take.
labels.warn_crew_exceeds_washers: This service needs more washers than are on duty: it cannot be booked.
labels.warn_bays_idle: Washers (÷ crew) limit the lines below the number of bays: some bays stay idle.
labels.warn_longer_than_day: The wash with the buffer is longer than the opening hours.

fields.bookingMaxCarsPerHour: Max cars starting per hour (0 = bays only)
fields.bookingMinFillSeconds: Minimum seconds to fill the form
fields.bookingDayCapacityPercent: Share of the day open to ONLINE booking, %
fields.bookingMaxCarsPerDay: Max cars per day (0 = computed only)

hints.bookingHoursMon: HH:MM-HH:MM. Type 'closed' to shut that weekday; empty = default hours.
hints.bookingPosts: How many cars can be on the ramps at once.
hints.bookingReminderHours: Needs the CRM cron (job BookingMaintenance, every 5 min).
hints.turnstileSiteKey: From the Cloudflare dashboard (Turnstile). Public: it is shown to visitors. Empty = no bot check.
hints.turnstileSecret: Write-only: kept on the server and never shown again. The check is on only while the secret is set; if Cloudflare is unreachable, booking is refused (closed).
hints.turnstileHostname: Empty = the host of the CRM address. Only for tests (Cloudflare's dummy keys answer example.com).
hints.bookingWashers: Empty = one per bay, so nothing changes for a wash that never set it. At no minute more cars are washed than bays, and the washers of those cars add up to at most this number.
hints.bookingWashersByWeekday: Optional: "Sat=4, Sun=4" (Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun). A day not listed uses the number above.
hints.bookingCrewDefault: Default for every service; a service can override it (Services -> Washers needed). Lines = bays or washers / crew, whichever is fewer.
hints.bookingDayCapacityPercent: The form and the chat stop offering times when this share of the day (lines x opening minutes) is booked. Walk-ins and staff reservations use the whole day. Empty = 100.
hints.bookingMaxCarsPerDay: A hard stop on the number of cars (reserved, on the bays and finished) in one day; staff may still book over it knowingly (manager).
